record.question: Name the British actress who is appointed as Goodwill Ambassador for United Nation's Women
record.explanation: Answer A: Emma Watson. Emma Watson was appointed UN Women Goodwill Ambassador in July 2014. UN Women's original newsletter records her appointment on 8 July 2014. Reference: https://www.unwomen.org/sites/default/files/Headquarters/Attachments/Sections/How%20We%20Work/UNSystemCoordination/Network%20newsletter/Network-2014-May-Aug-en.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
